title: Travala Introduces AVA Buyback Multiplier, Scaling Buybacks Up to 4x Member Rewards
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Singapore, Singapore, October 22nd, 2026] Travala’s monthly AVA Strategic Reserve buyback will now match up to 3x the AVA rewards earned by AVA Smart members Travala, the Binance-backed crypto travel booking platform, and the AVA Foundation—Travala’s loyalty program provider and issuer of the platform’s native AVA token—today announced the AVA Buyback Multiplier, […]
